title: Mistycraft
description: This is a modpack for my own minecraft server. Mostly vanilla+ themed mods with som extra technology mods.
body: This is a modpack for my own minecraft server. Mostly vanilla+ themed mods with som extra technology mods. The modpack is filled with lots of different mods. Like the create mod which is centered around rotation mechanics. You can automate simple tasks and chain together those automations into factory if you want. Or make a rocket and explore other space with the Ad Astra mod. Tired of sorting your storage, no problem Toms simple storage have you covered. With the Roughly Enough Items mod you dont need to remember recipes any more. Make a plane with Immersive Aircraft mod and fly around, explore the world. Make portals to other dimensions and much more.
